name: 21209 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21209 (Baltimore) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21209 (Baltimore) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
